segments.text: Coordinate a team of four engineers on the scheduling platform used by 40+ hospitals in India and the US.
Cut scheduling page loads from 4.2 seconds to 900 milliseconds by fixing the three queries behind 80% of slow requests; the customer went live a month early.
Rewrote the lab-feed retry logic overnight during a 900-bed hospital go-live; zero dropped messages in the twenty months since.
Added a pre-migration check after a 2022 incident that took 2 hours to restore; it has blocked 4 unsafe migrations since.
B.Tech in Computer Science, Vellore Institute of Technology, 2020
Since 2023, run a Saturday coding class for 12 government-school students in Bengaluru.

Senior Software Engineer, Meridian Health Systems (April 2024 to present). I coordinate 4 engineers on a scheduling platform that serves 40+ hospitals in India and the US. Promoted from Software Engineer two years ahead of the usual track.
Saturday coding class, Bengaluru (since 2023). I teach 12 government-school students, with three colleagues covering alternate Saturdays.

At 2 a.m., during the go-live at a 900-bed hospital in Chennai, the lab feed started dropping every fourth message. I rewrote the retry logic, called the vendor's on-call engineer, and got the batch window widened from 30 to 90 seconds before the 6 a.m. shift change.

I joined Meridian Health Systems as a Software Engineer in July 2020 and became a Senior Software Engineer in April 2024. Today I coordinate four engineers, and the lesson I took from that night is to ask for help sooner.

I spent a weekend instrumenting the scheduling module and found that three queries caused 80% of the slow requests. Fixing two of them took page loads from 4.2 seconds to 900 milliseconds, and the director shelved a six-month rewrite.
Outside work, I have run a Saturday coding class for twelve government-school students since 2023; four of them have moved on to a paid bootcamp.
Arjun was promoted to Senior Software Engineer in April 2024 and coordinates four engineers on the scheduling platform.
The go-live at the 900-bed hospital: he fixed the lab feed before the 6 a.m. shift change while you were on a flight.
